description:
Fetch the results of an AI-visibility scan started with scan_ai_visibility.

    Args:
        report_id: The id returned by scan_ai_visibility.

    Returns:
        While running: {status: "running", progress}. When done: the Tofu Index
        (named in the consideration set) and the Bofu Index (picked head to
        head), each with its fraction, the Tofu Index per engine, share of
        voice, sentiment, the top competitors winning the answers, any gap
        between the competitors the user named and the ones AI names, and
        top_fixes, the open items at the top of the brand's Fixes list (the same
        list the app's Fixes page shows; empty when there is none), plus the
        report_url.
name: get_visibility_report
